Grad Cafe Analytics

A small, tested service that scrapes self-reported graduate-admissions results from Grad Cafe, cleans and standardizes them, stores them in PostgreSQL, and serves an analysis page with Pull Data and Update Analysis actions.

This documentation covers how to set the project up, how the pieces fit together, the API of every module, and how the automated test suite works.
